proposition: A patch for Mysticism and Ordinator. The Vokrii patches are handled by the author on the Vokrii page.
This plugin patches all sources of Attack Speed in Simonrim. Comprehensive Attack Rate Patch is recommended to patch for sources of Attack Speed outside of Simonrim.
This plugin patches the Saints and Seducers creation for Adamant's smithing perks.
Adds a few spells that allow the player to increase their Warmth. Requires Survival Mode.
Adds a few spells which allows the player to fortify their Jump Height. Requires Po3Tweaks.
This addon replaces the Vanilla tempering progression with a new sysem that scales from +1 to +10. Requires Improvement Names Customized.
This patch integrates several Blade & Blunt features into Adamant perks. Highly recommended.
This addon integrates crossbow perks into the Adamant archery tree.

With this plugin installed, Apprentice spells will be available at 25 skill, Adept spells will be available at 50 skill, and Expert spells will be available at 75 skill. Master spells will continue to be available after completing the quest, which unlocks at 90 skill.
This optional file disables all kill moves, including ranged kill moves, without breaking the main quest.

Blade and Blunt changes the cost of power attacks. However, this change is not compatible with Ordinator's perks that reduce the cost of power attacking by a flat value. This addon reverts Blade and Blunt's changes to power attack cost back to Vanilla. Not recommended unless you are using Ordinator.
Blade and Blunt makes several changes to the Stamina cost of sprinting. This addon reverts those changes, for compatibility with mods such as Horseback or Unlimited sprinting.
Blade and Blunt disables Stamina regeneration while casting. This addon reverts that change.
Blade and Blunt adds a Stamina cost to sneaking. This addon reverts that change.
Blade and Blunt adds a Stamina cost to jumping. This addon reverts that change.
Blade and Blunt adds a Stamina cost to swimming. This addon reverts that change.
